::: {.callout-tip title="TL;DR" icon="false"}
An **agent** is a system that perceives state, reasons about it, and selects actions to pursue a
goal — iteratively, over multiple steps. The underlying model (transformer, SSM, or otherwise) is
one component; the **architecture** is how perception, memory, reasoning, and action are composed.
:::

## Landscape of agent architectures

| System | Backbone | Key capability |
|---|---|---|
| ReAct | LLM | interleaved reasoning + tool calls |
| AutoGPT / BabyAGI | LLM | autonomous task decomposition |
| RT-2 / OpenVLA | VLA transformer | embodied physical action |
| AlphaCode 2 | LLM | code agent with test execution |
